bullets.text: Pioneer’s Premium CarPlay Feature - **Pioneer** introduces the world’s first aftermarket spatial audio in-dash receiver with **Dolby Atmos** support.
Shokz OpenFit Pro Buds - New **Shokz** earbuds feature noise reduction, enhancing listening experiences in noisy environments.
Loona DeskMate AI Assistant - The **DeskMate** charging hub activates an AI companion app when an iPhone is connected.
Narwal’s AI Vacuum Cleaners - **Narwal** unveils smart vacuums that monitor pets and locate lost items using AI.
Nvidia’s GeForce Now Expansion - **Nvidia** announces native apps for Linux and Fire TV, enhancing cloud gaming accessibility.
Nvidia G-Sync Monitors - New **Nvidia** monitors automatically adjust brightness based on ambient lighting for optimal viewing.
Nvidia DLSS 4.5 Launch - **Nvidia** introduces DLSS 4.5, featuring 6x frame generation for enhanced gaming performance.
Emerson’s SmartVoice Appliances - **Emerson** launches appliances that respond to voice commands without needing Wi-Fi.
AMD’s AI PC Processors - **AMD** unveils the Ryzen AI 400 Series, promising faster multitasking and content creation.
Alienware’s New Gaming Laptops - **Alienware** announces plans for slim, affordable gaming laptops to attract a wider audience.
